summary: Inventory large SQLite value source sites, review proposed deltas, and enforce explicit transitional owner TODOs

replay.detail: No replay or runtime code changes; existing admitted and historical values remain accepted.

schema.detail: No DDL, storage representation, schema version, threshold or logical input cap change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules, digests and retention authority are unchanged. This documents a source storage rule.

compatibility.detail: No wire, client, runtime or value contract change. The source guard adds ordinary CI coverage only.

downtime.detail: No migration, conversion, stop or deployment procedure.

manual.detail: No operator step. Representation and conversion work require their own storage and contract decisions.

recovery.detail: No data changes. Transitional source exceptions and their removal remain reviewable in the inventory.
